_doc: Curated Insight tip catalog — the offline seed + canon for the `insight_tips` T3 table (insights v6). Each tip is a TEMPLATE (payload.bodyTemplate with {placeholder} tokens) + a TRIGGER (selectors). The client computes the user's REAL pattern over their completion history (program_day_items), evaluates `selectors`, fills the template with the real numbers, and surfaces the tip ONLY when its real threshold is met — so no fabricated stat ever reaches a user. Tones come from InsightsPaletteV6. Generate the Supabase seed from this file (id/payload/selectors/category/order_index/version/is_published map 1:1 to columns). `id` is STABLE.

payload.headline: {weekday} is your engine.
payload.bodyTemplate: You're {pct}% more likely to clear every task on a {weekday} than any other day. Lean into it.

payload.headline: {streak}-day streak — mind day {riskDay}.
payload.bodyTemplate: Across people at this point, day {riskDay} is the most common drop-off. The brain reads "I've made it" as permission to coast. Don't.

payload.headline: You're on the rise.
payload.bodyTemplate: Your completion rate climbed from {prevPct}% to {recentPct}% over the last two weeks. Momentum is real.

payload.headline: Weekends slip.
payload.bodyTemplate: You finish {weekdayPct}% on weekdays but only {weekendPct}% on weekends. A lighter weekend plan beats a broken one.

payload.headline: Welcome back.
payload.bodyTemplate: You missed {gapDays} days and still returned. The comeback is the muscle that actually matters.

payload.headline: You lean {pillar}.
payload.bodyTemplate: {pct}% of your wins are {pillar} tasks. That's a real strength — a little balance elsewhere compounds it.

payload.headline: Perfect week.
payload.bodyTemplate: Every task, every day, seven days straight. This is what your baseline can become.

payload.headline: Mornings are yours.
payload.bodyTemplate: You clear {morningPct}% of your morning tasks. Front-loading the hard ones plays to your strength.

payload.headline: Your evenings fade.
payload.bodyTemplate: You finish {morningPct}% of morning tasks but only {eveningPct}% of evening ones. By 9pm, willpower runs thin — schedule the important reps earlier.

payload.headline: The file is open.
payload.bodyTemplate: {taskCount} tasks logged. We're starting to see what you reach for first.
